name: huawei-cup-23-math-modeling
description: A competition-aware, evidence-first workflow for the 23rd Huawei Cup Chinese Graduate Mathematical Modeling Contest.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $huawei-cup-23-math-modeling to complete this Huawei Cup 23 mathematical-modeling task. First inspect the problem and official attachments, then run the evidence-first workflow and stop at any unresolved rule or verification failure.
